title: Brazil Presidential Race Heads to Second Round
subtitle: Flávio Bolsonaro leads incumbent Lula da Silva as the nation prepares for a final showdown on October 25.

summary.en: Brazil's presidential election will move to a second round after no candidate secured a majority. Far-right challenger Flávio Bolsonaro finished ahead of current president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the first round of voting. With over 99% of votes counted, Bolsonaro received 47.1% compared to Lula's 45%. The result highlights a deep divide in the country's political landscape. Voters will return to the polls on October 25 to decide the nation's future.
summary.zh: 巴西總統大選因無候選人取得過半票數，將進入第二輪決選。在第一輪投票中，極右派挑戰者弗拉維奧·波索納洛的得票數領先現任總統魯拉。在已開出超過百分之九十九的選票中，波索納洛獲得百分之四十七點一，魯拉則為百分之四十五。此結果凸顯了該國政治版圖的嚴重分裂。選民將於十月二十五日重返投票所，決定國家的未來。

paragraphs.en: Brazil’s presidential election is officially heading to a second round after a tense first round of voting. The far-right candidate, Flávio Bolsonaro, finished ahead of the current left-wing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, but did not receive enough votes to win the election outright. According to The Guardian, with more than 99% of the votes counted, the 45-year-old Bolsonaro secured 47.1% of the vote, while the 80-year-old Lula received 45%. Because neither candidate reached the required majority, the two will face each other in a final showdown on October 25.
paragraphs.zh: 巴西總統大選在經歷緊張的第一輪投票後，正式進入第二輪決選。極右派候選人弗拉維奧·波索納洛（Flávio Bolsonaro）得票數領先現任左派總統路易斯·伊納西奧·魯拉·達席爾瓦（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva），但因未取得過半票數而無法直接勝出。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，在已開出超過百分之九十九的選票中，四十五歲的波索納洛獲得百分之四十七點一的選票，而八十歲的魯拉則獲得百分之四十五。由於兩位候選人都未達到規定的多數門檻，雙方將於十月二十五日進行最終對決。

paragraphs.en: This election is being closely watched as a critical moment for the future of Latin America’s largest democracy. In the days leading up to the vote, the atmosphere in the country was tense. While casting his ballot in the industrial area of São Bernardo do Campo, President Lula told reporters that the country faced a very clear choice. He described the election as a battle between strengthening democracy and what he called “barbarism.” Lula, who has served as president multiple times, is hoping to win a historic fourth term. His supporters view this election as a vital fight to prevent the return of a far-right movement that they say caused chaos in the capital, Brasília, four years ago.
paragraphs.zh: 這場選舉被視為拉丁美洲最大民主國家未來發展的關鍵時刻，受到各界密切關注。在投票前的幾天裡，國內氣氛相當緊繃。魯拉總統在聖貝納多-杜坎普（São Bernardo do Campo）的工業區投票時向記者表示，國家面臨著非常明確的抉擇。他將這場選舉形容為強化民主與他口中所謂「野蠻行徑」之間的對抗。曾多次擔任總統的魯拉，希望能贏得歷史性的第四個任期。他的支持者將此次選舉視為一場至關重要的戰役，旨在防止四年前曾在首都巴西利亞（Brasília）引發混亂的極右派勢力捲土重來。

paragraphs.en: On the other side, Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, has campaigned on a promise to change the country’s direction. After voting in Rio de Janeiro, he spoke against what he described as Lula’s “era of backwardness.” Bolsonaro has promised to take a very tough approach to crime, even though he has faced questions about his connections to local paramilitary groups. He has also made it clear that he hopes to use the presidency to help his father, who is currently serving a 27-year prison sentence for plotting a failed coup — an attempt to illegally take control of the government after losing the previous election.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，前總統雅伊爾·波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）之子弗拉維奧·波索納洛，以改變國家方向作為競選承諾。他在里約熱內盧（Rio de Janeiro）投完票後，公開抨擊他所稱的魯拉「落後時代」。儘管波索納洛曾因與當地準軍事組織的關聯而面臨質疑，他仍承諾將對犯罪採取強硬手段。他也明確表示，希望利用總統職權協助其父親；其父目前因策劃一場失敗的政變——即在輸掉上次選舉後企圖非法奪取政府控制權——而正在服二十七年刑期。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the presidential race, the first round of voting showed that the far-right movement in Brazil is stronger than many experts expected. According to The Guardian, several members of the Bolsonaro family and their allies won important positions in the government. This includes seats in the senate and the lower house of congress. Furthermore, Tarcísio de Freitas, a former infrastructure minister, was reelected as the governor of São Paulo, which is Brazil’s most important state for the economy. Out of 54 senate seats, 34 were won by candidates from the right or far-right, signaling a significant shift in the country's political power.
paragraphs.zh: 除了總統大選外，第一輪投票結果顯示，巴西極右派勢力的強大程度超乎許多專家的預期。根據《衛報》報導，波索納洛家族的多名成員及其盟友贏得了政府中的重要職位，包括參議院與眾議院的席次。此外，前基礎設施部長塔西西奧·德·弗雷塔斯（Tarcísio de Freitas）成功連任巴西經濟最重要的聖保羅州（São Paulo）州長。在五十四個參議院席次中，有三十四席由右派或極右派候選人贏得，這標誌著該國政治權力結構的重大轉變。

paragraphs.en: As the country prepares for the final vote on October 25, both sides are now looking for support from voters who chose other candidates in the first round. Analysts believe that Bolsonaro enters the second round as the favorite. He is expected to gain support from the voters of other right-wing candidates who did not make it to the final round. For example, candidates like Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos, who received a small percentage of the vote, represent a pool of potential supporters for the Bolsonaro campaign.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著國家為十月二十五日的最終投票做準備，雙方陣營目前都在爭取第一輪投票中選擇其他候選人的選民支持。分析人士認為，波索納洛在進入第二輪時佔有優勢。預計他將能獲得其他未進入決選的右派候選人支持者的選票。例如，像羅納度·卡亞多（Ronaldo Caiado）與雷南·桑托斯（Renan Santos）等得票率較低的候選人，皆代表了波索納洛陣營潛在的支持者群體。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, allies of President Lula are calling for tactical voting. This is a strategy where people vote for a candidate they might not fully support just to stop a different candidate from winning. Talíria Petrone, a left-wing congresswoman, argued that even those who do not like Lula should vote for him to ensure that the Bolsonaro family does not return to power. She warned that Brazilian democracy is at stake in this election.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，魯拉總統的盟友正呼籲採取策略性投票。這是一種選民為了阻止特定候選人勝出，而將票投給自己未必完全支持的候選人的策略。左派國會議員塔莉亞·佩特羅內（Talíria Petrone）主張，即使是不喜歡魯拉的人，也應該投給他，以確保波索納洛家族不會重掌政權。她警告說，巴西的民主正處於這場選舉的危急關頭。

paragraphs.en: For now, the country remains divided. The upcoming weeks will be a period of intense campaigning as both candidates try to win over the remaining undecided voters. Whether the nation chooses to continue with Lula’s leadership or moves toward the vision offered by Flávio Bolsonaro, the result on October 25 will have long-lasting effects on Brazil’s political and social future. The world will be watching closely to see which path the voters choose in this high-stakes contest.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，國家依然處於分裂狀態。接下來的幾週將是激烈的競選期，兩位候選人都將竭力爭取剩餘尚未決定投票意向的選民。無論國家選擇繼續由魯拉領導，還是走向弗拉維奧·波索納洛所提出的願景，十月二十五日的結果都將對巴西的政治與社會未來產生深遠影響。全世界都將密切關注，在這場高風險的競爭中，選民最終會選擇哪一條道路。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Immediately or completely, without any delay or further steps.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此處並非形容詞（如 outright lie），而是副詞，表示「直接贏得選舉」。文中：but did not receive enough votes to win the election outright.

keyTerms.definitionEn: At risk; in a situation where it could be lost or damaged.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於新聞報導，表示某事物正處於關鍵時刻，若失敗則會失去。文中：She warned that Brazilian democracy is at stake in this election.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To persuade someone to support you or agree with you.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 爭取（某人的）支持、說服某人站在自己這邊。
keyTerms.noteZh: 由動詞 win 和介系詞 over 組成，意思與單純的「贏」不同。文中：The upcoming weeks will be a period of intense campaigning as both candidates try to win over the remaining undecided voters.

previousArticles.summaryEn: Brazil has finished voting in the first round of a very important presidential election. The current president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, is facing a strong challenge from senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The election is seen as a battle between two very different visions for the country. If no candidate wins more than half of the votes, a second round will take place on October 25. The result of this vote will likely affect the political direction of the entire Latin American region.

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the primary reason the presidential election must proceed to a second round?

options.A: The current president, Lula da Silva, requested a recount due to the narrow margin.
options.B: Neither candidate secured the required majority of votes in the first round.
options.C: The election board discovered irregularities in the votes cast in São Paulo.
options.D: Flávio Bolsonaro failed to win the support of the paramilitary groups.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，文中明確指出「Because neither candidate reached the required majority, the two will face each other in a final showdown」。選項 A 錯誤，文中未提到重計票；選項 C 錯誤，文中未提及選舉舞弊；選項 D 雖然提到 Bolsonaro 與準軍事組織的關聯，但這並非進入第二輪選舉的原因。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the political landscape in Brazil following the first round of voting?

options.A: The far-right movement has gained significant influence beyond just the presidency.
options.B: Lula da Silva is expected to easily win the second round due to his past experience.
options.C: Voters in São Paulo are overwhelmingly in favor of the current left-wing government.
options.D: The Bolsonaro family has lost all support in the senate and lower house.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。根據第四段，文章提到右派與極右派贏得了參議院多數席次，且 Bolsonaro 的盟友在政府中獲得了重要職位，顯示該派系勢力擴張。選項 B 與文章提到 Bolsonaro 是第二輪熱門人選的分析相左；選項 C 錯誤，因為該州選出了右派州長；選項 D 與原文敘述相反，Bolsonaro 的家人與盟友實際上贏得了重要職位。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the phrase 'tactical voting' mean in the context of the election?

options.A: Voting for a candidate solely to prevent a less desirable opponent from winning.
options.B: Changing one's political party affiliation immediately before the election day.
options.C: Focusing only on the voters who live in the most important industrial states.
options.D: Using military strategies to influence how people cast their ballots in the capital.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文章第六段解釋「tactical voting」為「a strategy where people vote for a candidate they might not fully support just to stop a different candidate from winning」，意即為了阻止特定候選人當選而進行的策略性投票。選項 B、C、D 皆與文中對該術語的定義無關，屬於對單詞的錯誤延伸解釋。

quiz.question: What is the central theme of this article?

options.A: A detailed biography of the political careers of the Bolsonaro family.
options.B: The economic consequences of the recent infrastructure projects in São Paulo.
options.C: The history of the failed coup attempt in the capital city of Brasília.
options.D: The intense political division and the high stakes of Brazil's upcoming presidential runoff.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。全文圍繞著巴西總統大選第一輪後的結果、兩位候選人的立場、極右派勢力的崛起以及對即將到來的第二輪投票的展望，強調這場選舉對巴西未來的關鍵性。選項 A、B、C 皆僅為文章中的部分細節或背景資訊，無法涵蓋全文探討的選舉現況與政治僵局之核心主旨。
